info.title: Decision MVP API
info.description: Single-owner CONTRACT v1. No registration. Device tokens are restricted to heartbeat, observation upload, own deliveries/acks and owned jobs. Mock mode is explicit and disabled by default.

post.description: Owner only. Atomically saves a Problem, original user message and chat Job. Replaying a key never creates another conversation. New goal is empty until explicitly supplied; optional naming uses the first answer call only.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same subject/path/key and payload replays the response; changed payload returns 409.

post.description: Owner only. Failed chat jobs only (otherwise 409 JOB_NOT_RETRYABLE). Reuses the original user message. One persisted retry child per failed job across all keys; returns that child even if it has since failed. Retry that new failed child for another attempt. Before creating a child, withdrawn/deleted/obsolete original messages return 409 CONTEXT_CHANGED. No duplicate user message or automatic retry.

get.description: Owner only; device denied. Original binary, nosniff, no-store and safe attachment Content-Disposition. Never put token in URL.

goal.description: Empty for chat-first conversations until the owner supplies a goal. Legacy POST /problems still requires a non-empty goal.

result.description: chat: userMessageId,assistantMessageId; source_ingest: sourceId,topicIds; topic_sync: topicId,wikiUrl; analysis: discussionIds

dataUrl.description: Base64 data URL only; PNG/JPEG, PDF/DOCX/XLSX, UTF-8 TXT/MD/CSV. 8 MiB decoded per file; total 16 MiB.
